# Acute Care Simulation Lab

Welcome to the University of Oregon Acute Care Simulation Lab.

Each simulation is designed to mirror the clinical reasoning process used by Speech-Language Pathologists in the acute care setting. Select a simulation below to begin.

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.chart-card}
## 🧠 Simulation 1

### Initial Patient Contact

Acute ischemic stroke with altered mental status requiring an initial Speech-Language Pathology consultation.

Students will complete:

- Case Overview
- Chart Review
- Vital Signs
- Bedside Contact
- Clinical Impression & Recommendations
